page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with a running head at the top and the page number at the top right. Below the text, FINIS centred. No margin notes.

main_text.l: bus sibi ministrari putat Beveregius abunde
etiam vel à Dallæo vel à nobis satisfactum
est, necnon iis omnibus quæ à vetustiori-
bus Scriptoribus & ab antiquis deprompsit
Synodis ad eandem Canonum antiquita-
tem stabiliendam ac confirmandam. Qua-
mobrem hîc sisto gradum, etsi plures ad-
huc in annotationes Beveregianas fieri pos-
sent observationes, cum in eas quibus Ca-
nones illustravit Apostolicos, tum in alias
quibus cæteris Canonibus aliquam lucem
afferre conatus est: sed ne scribendi cacoë-
the me laborare putet eruditissimus Beve-
regius, hoc labore haud invitus superse-
deo: Eo magis quod præstantissimum Dal-
læum Virum nunquam satis laudatum ad-
versus duos celeberrimos adversarios tue-
ri ac defendere tantùm mihi propositum
fuit: an id recte præstiterim necne, alio-
rum esto judicium.
FINIS.

page.notes: The first line begins with a fragment ("bus"), which is kept as printed. Hyphenated line breaks are kept with their printed hyphens. The reading "necne" is set as printed in the scan, which is slightly blurred at that point. The stamp and the digitiser's watermark are left out.
